claims.evidence: The model bizhub PRO C754e is a known high-volume color laser MFP.
The meter reading screen was not shown in the report.

claims.claim: New drum and toner just fitted
claims.evidence: Internal components and the consumables status screen were not photographed.
The machine was not shown powered on or in operation.

risks.risk: The machine may not power on or has a faulty mainboard.
risks.proof: A video showing the machine booting up to the main menu screen.

risks.risk: The actual page count could be significantly higher than claimed (high-mileage).
risks.proof: A clear photo of the 'Meter Count' or 'Counter' screen.
risks.if_unproven: As a high-mileage unit nearing end-of-life.

risks.risk: Print quality may be poor due to scratched drums or depleted developer.
risks.proof: A photo of a freshly printed 'Demo Page' or 'Graduation Pattern'.
risks.if_unproven: As requiring a full set of new drums and developer units.

risks.risk: Environmental damage (moisture or dust) from being stored on a rough concrete floor/outdoors.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the internal paper feed rollers and the scanner glass.
risks.if_unproven: As having potential mechanical degradation from improper storage.

proof_requests: Photo of the Meter Count screen showing total prints.
Video of the machine powering on and completing a self-test.
Photo of the 'Consumables' or 'Service Mode' screen showing toner and drum life percentages.
A test print or configuration page printed during the inspection.
response.reason: The model is clearly identified by the witness, allowing for a baseline valuation; however, without proof of life or meter readings, it must be priced as a non-functional unit for parts.
